name: fix_java_concurrent_modification_remove
description: Fixes a Java loop that removes from a list while iterating it, throwing ConcurrentModificationException
prompts: Evens.removeEvens in src/main/java/com/optarena/Evens.java should remove every even number from the list in place, but it calls nums.remove(n) inside a for-each loop over the same list, which throws ConcurrentModificationException. Fix it so it removes exactly the even numbers (leaving the odd ones in their original order) without throwing - use Collection.removeIf or an explicit Iterator with iterator.remove(). Keep the class and method signature.
